title: fix(pm): read a record's Head-sha line only below its heading, refuse an unreadable one at write time, and name the line in the rules
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DHcz5tQsg7ziuDgABaqcfbH)_

domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czYNVYrGQqbs51hpvv

Fixes #28024

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：契约复核记录「审的是哪个 head」现在只从它自己 `## Contract review` 题头**之下**、第一条不带引用块、不带列表符、不在代码围栏里的 `Head-sha:` 行读；题头之前、引用、列表、围栏里的 `Head-sha:` 行一律当散文。写入侧 `post-stamped.mjs` 在发评论前就拒收「带 `Head-sha` 键但读器读不出 head」的记录。规则文 `contract-review.md:33` 点名这一行。4 个文件，+141/−32，无新门禁。
- 为什么改：PR #28023 之后读器取的是全文第一条 `Head-sha:` 键行，且容忍引用块和列表符。于是一条引用别人记录的 `> Head-sha: B` 若排在自己那行之上，记录就被读成「审过 B」（复核探针实测：在 B 找到、在真 head 缺席）。这是三条 should-fix 里唯一能放进错 head 的一条，另两条是让作者早点知道。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧不放宽。实测 2026-10-23 至 30 的 709 条题头记录：707 条本来就是题头下的裸行，2 条无 `Head-sha` 键（已知旧写法，PR 已合并），0 条在新读法下读数改变。读不出的记录读为「无 head」，补发一条正确的记录即可；写入侧的拒收会在发出前就说明哪一行坏了。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `contractReviewHeadSha` 与 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEAD_SHA_LINE`（所有读者只经这一个函数取 head）；`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` 的 `recordKeyedLineRefusals`（导入同一读器，不重拼）；`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md:33`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --self-test`，预期两者 exit 0（5102 与 743 例），其中含「引用行在上、真行在下：在引用 head 缺席、在真 head 找到」的钉子。
- 需要你做的：无。本 PR 触及 `.claude/**` 受管规则文，欠一轮契约复核（席位安排，CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER）；落地档位以登记册为准（`check-governed-merges.mjs --test` 读为 Tier S，`--pr` 在 PR 上再读一次）。

## What changes

Follow-up to PR #28023 (#27979), closing its review's should-fixes 1–3. Triage ruling: edge 1 is the one that can admit a wrong head; edges 2 and 3 are loudness; no new gate.

- **Edge 1 — the reader** (`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`). `contractReviewHeadSha(body)` now returns the span on the FIRST `Head-sha:` line BELOW the record's own `## Contract review` heading (read with `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEADING_MARKER`, blockquoted heading included, exactly as the locator finds the record), skipping every line inside a fenced code block (three or more backticks or tildes; an unclosed fence runs to the end, as it renders). `CONTRACT_REVIEW_HEAD_SHA_LINE` drops the blockquote and bullet tolerances the `keyLineRegex` convention keeps for `Served-tier:`, `Reviewed-by:` and `Local-runs:`: those values describe the record; this line decides which head a PASS clears, and a quoted or bulleted `Head-sha:` line is one the author cited rather than wrote. Bold and backticks on the key, a trailing span on the line, and CRLF still read. Every reader reaches the head through this one function — `latestContractReviewOnHead` (H43), `locateReviewOfRecord`, owed-reviews `recordReading`, the queue guard's `recordVerdict` — so they move together; no other file changes a predicate.
- **Edge 3 — the write side** (`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`). `recordKeyedLineRefusals` refuses a `## Contract review` comment that carries a `Head-sha` key anywhere (case-blind presence test) for which the imported `contractReviewHeadSha` reads `null`, before the write and beside the existing `Local-runs:` row; a record with no key at all is not re-judged (the two retired-dialect records carry none). `RECORD_KEY_SPELLINGS` prints the accepted shape; the refusal names the owner. Imported from `check-half-states.mjs`, which the file already imports at module scope — no new edge, no cycle (both self-tests that load the graph pass).
- **Edge 2 — the rules text** (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md:33`). 「head sha 独占码段」 becomes 「`Head-sha:` 行独占码段」. 60 lines before and after; the line is 117 bytes under the 120-byte cap.
- **Pins.** H51 battery (`check-half-states.mjs`): the four probe shapes from the #28023 review — a `Head-sha:` line naming another head placed before the heading, blockquoted, bulleted, fenced, each above the record's own — read absent at the cited head and found at the real one; a quoted, bulleted or fenced line alone, a line with no heading above it, and a line inside an unclosed fence name no head; tilde fence and CRLF. Locator battery (`record-recognisers.mjs`, floor 10 to 13): the same shapes through `locateReviewOfRecord` on the PR thread and the card. `post-stamped.mjs` battery (floor 9 to 17): each unreadable shape refused, the quoted-above-real shape passes, absent not re-judged, both rows together, the structural import pin now covers both readers.

## Tests

Self-tests on the committed head `fd3f1f3e`, exit codes captured before any pipe:

| Command | Exit | Cases |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test` | 0 | 5102 (5089 on the base of #28023) |
| `node scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs --self-test` | 0 | 336 |
| `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --self-test` | 0 | 743 across 26 batteries |
| `node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test` | 0 | 65 in 9 batteries |
| `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` | 0 | 403 |

Ablations, one per new leg, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, blob hash moved, restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty on every leg):

| Leg | Mutation | Red pins |
|:--|:--|:--|
| heading scope | `let belowHeading = true` | half-states 3 of 5102, recognisers 1 of 336 (the pre-heading pin), post-stamped 1 of 743 |
| blockquote / bullet refusal | `(?:>[ \t]*)?(?:[-*][ \t]+)?` restored into the key regex | half-states 3, recognisers 2, post-stamped 4 |
| fence skip | `if (fenced && false) continue` | half-states 4, recognisers 2, post-stamped 1 |
| write-time refusal | `if (false && …)` in `recordKeyedLineRefusals` | post-stamped 5 of 743 |

A first attempt at the heading-scope leg mutated the assignment inside the loop (`belowHeading = true; continue`), which also skipped the first line and so stayed green; it was discarded and re-run as the initialiser mutation above. Both runs are in the report.

## Acceptance notes

- **Measured before changing the accept set** (REST `issues/comments?since=2026-10-23`, 113 pages, 11,236 comments, at `origin/main` `e1dde1a5c`): 709 bodies with a line-initial `## Contract review`; 707 carry their first readable `Head-sha:` line plain and below the heading; 2 carry no `Head-sha` key (6360650327 on PR #25399, 6397040906 on PR #25774 — the retired dialects, both PRs merged); 0 blockquoted, bulleted, bold-key, backticked-key, fenced or pre-heading first lines; 0 blockquoted headings; 1 body with more than one `Head-sha` key line (the #28023 review record, whose prose names the key mid-sentence; its first line is the real one). 0 records read differently under the new reader.
- `keyLineRegex` still tolerates blockquote and bullet for `Served-tier:`, `Reviewed-by:` and `Local-runs:`; only the head line is stricter, for the reason in its docblock. Not changed here.
- The template's null-oid placeholder is 40 hex and reads as a head, so `post-stamped` does not refuse a pasted template; C6 refuses it at the locator, as before.
- Scope: exactly the four files the claim names (record-recognisers.mjs for pins only). No production predicate outside `check-half-states.mjs` and `post-stamped.mjs` moved.
- `skip-changeset`: `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` only, nothing published.

## Verification

Local gates on the committed head `fd3f1f3e`, from a second worktree at the same commit (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`, then `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint` for the formula gate), exit codes captured before any pipe:

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 56 families for the 4 changed paths (+141 / −32, under the human-merge threshold).
- All 56 ran and exited 0 — among them `check:pm-half-states`, `check:pm-post-stamped`, `check:pm-record-recognisers` (recognisers + owed-reviews + mailbox-open + fleet-roster self-tests), `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-skill-ratchet` (the line budget and the 120-byte line cap), `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:commit-card-trailers`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.txt`: 56 derived, 56 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (exit 0).
- `pnpm lint` (the repo-wide ESLint sweep) is CI-owned and was not run locally; read it off the PR check-runs.
- Landing tier: `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --test` on the four paths answers Tier S (`.claude/**` ×1, the three `scripts/pm/**` paths not on the register); the seat reads `--pr` on this PR.
